# New field for discount classes on `DraftOrderPlatformDiscount`

DateJuly 1, 2025

Version[2025-07](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-07)

Flags[Deprecation announcement](https://shopify.dev/changelog?filter=deprecation-announcement)[Action required](https://shopify.dev/changelog?action_required=true)

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

The `discountClass` field in the `DraftOrderPlatformDiscount` object has been deprecated. Please use the `discountClasses` field instead, which allows for the representation of multiple discount classes associated with the backing price rule of the `DraftOrderPlatformDiscount`.

To determine the specific impact of a `DraftOrderPlatformDiscount` on a draft order, continue using the [`presentationLevel`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/objects/DraftOrderPlatformDiscount#field-presentationlevel) field.
